content_preview.title: CachyOS's August 2026 Release Rewrites Shelly Package Manager From C# to Zig, Previews Server Edition
content_preview.summary: CachyOS's August 2026 release rewrites the Shelly package manager from C# to Zig, moves the kernel-manager backend and Cachy-Update applet to Rust, and adds experimental Server Edition installer profiles.
content_preview.body_excerpt:
## Overview

CachyOS, the performance-optimized Arch-based Linux distribution, shipped its August 2026 release on August 9, according to [Phoronix](https://www.phoronix.com/news/CachyOS-August-2026) and [Linuxiac](https://linuxiac.com/cachyos-august-2026-release-rewrites-shelly-in-zig-prepares-server-edition/). The release rewrites Shelly, the project's default graphical package manager, from C# to Zig, and lands the first experimental installer profiles for the upcoming CachyOS Server Edition.

editor_notes.content_quality: Clean, well-organized News piece (609 words) using the Overview / What We Know / What We Don't Know structure. Every specific in the body is attributed inline to the outlet that reported it (Phoronix, Linuxiac, or the official CachyOS announcement), and the 'What We Don't Know' section correctly flags that no source gives a Server Edition release date or Shelly benchmark figures, rather than inventing either.
editor_notes.source_verification: All 3 sources read from the gzipped snapshots in sources/2026-08/cachyoss-august-2026-release-rewrites-shelly-package-manager-from-c-to-zig-previews-server-edition/ and sha256-verified against manifest.json (all three hashes matched exactly): (1) source-0.html.gz — cachyos.org/blog/2608-august-release/, the official CachyOS project blog post announcing the August 2026 release. Confirms: fifth release of the year, Shelly rewritten C# to Zig with a new welcome screen/list-grid views/AUR PKGBUILD preview/TOML backup import-export, shelly-flatpak-backend now optional, chwd kernel-manager backend C++ to Rust integrated into chwd-kernel, Cachy-Update rebased on Arch-Update 4.x with Rust systray applet, --check --enable flag, TrayUpdatesPerPage, 6-hour default interval, CLI installer experimental Server Edition profiles, Hyprland/Noctalia now uses noctalia-greeter, Cinnamon uses lightdm-slick-greeter, gvfs-dnssd for GNOME, cosmic-monitor for COSMIC, Noctalia variants for Mango/Niri, Noctalia v5 Hyprland dotfiles, updated Nord KDE theme for Plasma 6.7, CachyOS-Welcome DNS ranking fix, cachyos-rate-mirrors using the CachyOS mirrorlist API, gaming wiki launch-option cleanup, and 'sudo pacman -Syu' as the only migration step. All matched the article verbatim in substance. (2) source-1.html.gz — phoronix.com/news/CachyOS-August-2026, byline Michael Larabel. Confirms chwd kernel-manager backend C++→Rust, Cachy Update systray Rust rewrite, Shelly C#→Zig, CLI installer prep for Server Edition, gaming wiki updates. The article's direct quote 'latest media refresh of the year' attributed to Phoronix appears verbatim: 'CachyOS is out with its latest media refresh of the year.' (3) source-2.html.gz — linuxiac.com, byline Bobby Borisov. Confirms Linux kernel 7.1, fifth ISO refresh of the year, all Shelly desktop/CLI feature details, Cachy-Update rebase/Rust/flags, all desktop-specific installer changes (noctalia-greeter, lightdm-slick-greeter, gvfs-dnssd, cosmic-monitor), Noctalia/Nord theme updates, CachyOS-Welcome DNS fix, mirrorlist API, gaming doc cleanup re: proton-cachyos-slr, and 'sudo pacman -Syu' migration guidance. No hallucinated quotes or misattributed specifics found across any of the three sources — every direct quote and numeric/technical detail in the article traces to the outlet it is attributed to.
